  875: gui_found_namespace(Ns,Config) ->
  876:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({runtime,Ns}),
  877:     try
  878:         {ok,_} = quod_ns_sup:start_namespace(Ns,Config),
  879:         receive {replay_ready,_,_} -> quod_simplex:genesis_hash(Ns)
  880:         after 10000 -> error({gui_namespace_not_ready,Ns}) end
  881:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({runtime,Ns}) end.
  882: 
  883: gui_bind_node(Ns,Anchor) ->
  884:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({node_actor,node}),
  885:     try
  886:         {ok,Principal} = quod_node_actor:bind(Ns,Anchor,<<"physical_node.">>,3),
  887:         receive {node_actor_installed,_,{ok,Principal}} -> ok
  888:         after 10000 -> error(gui_node_not_installed) end
  889:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({node_actor,node}) end.
  890: 
  891: %% peer uses standard_io with a nondistributed CT parent. Keep socket delivery
  892: %% and its processing barriers inside the receiver VM; RPC carries assertions.
  893: gui_receiver_start(Ctx,Ns,Anchor) ->
  894:     Session = quod_gui_question_tests:gui_session(Ctx),
  895:     spawn(fun() ->
  896:         Parent = self(),
  897:         {Hud,M} = spawn_monitor(fun() -> quod_gui_question_tests:gui_socket(Parent,#{peer => {127,0,0,1}},true) end),
  898:         Message = fun() -> quod_gui_question_tests:gui_open_message(Ctx,Session,gui_hud,Ns,Anchor,none,0) end,
  899:         gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message)
  900:     end).
  901: 
  902: gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message) ->
  903:     receive
  904:         {'$gen_call',From,renew} ->
  905:             Hud ! {client,Message()},
  906:             Projection = gui_receiver_projection(Hud,Message,quod_time:mono_ms()+15000),
  907:             gen_server:reply(From,Projection),gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message);
  908:         {'$gen_call',From,activated} ->
  909:             receive {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"gui_prepare">>}} -> ok
  910:             after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_prepare_missing) end,
  911:             receive {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"gui_activate">>}} -> ok
  912:             after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_activation_missing) end,
  913:             gen_server:reply(From,ok),gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message);
  914:         {'$gen_call',From,stop} ->
  915:             Hud ! stop,
  916:             receive {'DOWN',M,process,Hud,normal} -> gen_server:reply(From,ok)
  917:             after 5000 -> error(remote_gui_not_closed) end;
  918:         {'DOWN',M,process,Hud,Reason} -> error({remote_gui_socket_down,Reason})
  919:     end.
  920: 
  921: gui_receiver_projection(Hud,Message,Deadline) ->
  922:     receive
  923:         {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"projection">>} = Projection} -> Projection;
  924:         {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"refresh">>}} ->
  925:             Hud ! {client,Message()},gui_receiver_projection(Hud,Message,Deadline);
  926:         %% Like the portable signed-view client, wait for the owner's refresh
  927:         %% when an earlier subscription is still being retired. No retry timer.
  928:         {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"unavailable">>,
  929:                         <<"reason">> := <<"dependency_recovering">>}} ->
  930:             gui_receiver_projection(Hud,Message,Deadline);
  931:         {gui_view,Hud,Other} -> error({remote_gui_projection_failed,Other})
  932:     after max(0,Deadline-quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  933:         Ref = make_ref(),Hud ! {inspect,Ref},
  934:         receive {Ref,State} -> error({remote_gui_projection_missing,
  935:             maps:with([installed,pending,follows,follow_requests,owners,local_ready],State),
  936:             quod_foreign_log:stats()})
  937:         after 1000 -> error(remote_gui_socket_unresponsive) end
  938:     end.
  939: 
  940: gui_host_actor(Ctx,Actor = {agent_instance_ref,Ns,_,_},Node,Key) ->
  941:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent_hosting,Ns}),
  942:     try
  943:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},quod_lobby_tests:submit(Ctx,execute,
  944:             {'::',<<"quod:agent">>,{goal,{agent_hosted,Actor,Node,1,Key}}})),
  945:         receive {agent_installed,_,_,#{reference := Actor},_} -> ok
  946:         after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_actor_not_installed) end
  947:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent_hosting,Ns}) end.
  948: 
  949: gui_complete_answer(Ctx,Actor = {agent_instance_ref,Ns,Anchor,_},Q,Goal) ->
  950:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent,Actor}),
  951:     try
  952:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},quod_lobby_tests:submit(Ctx,execute,Goal)),
  953:         receive {agent_request_finished,_,_,#{reference := Actor},_,Result} ->
  954:             {ok,#{request_bytes := Bytes},{normalized,{committed,_,_}}} = Result,
  955:             {ok,#{goal_text := Text}} = quod_client_goal:decode(Bytes),
  956:             {ok,Expected} = quod_client_goal_parser:format(gui({gui_complete,{question_ref,Ns,Anchor,Q}})),
  957:             ?assertEqual(quod_client_goal_parser:parse(Expected,3),quod_client_goal_parser:parse(Text,3)),ok
  958:         after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_completion_missing) end
  959:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent,Actor}) end.
  960: 
  961: %% The same live observer now lies in its next signed directory generation and
  962: %% labels itself a validator. Its key sorts before the real validator, so a
  963: %% role-trusting selector would open the scope there. The certified target
  964: %% committee removes it and resolution reaches the honest coexisting route.
  965: remote_plain_read_rejects_lying_validator(Config) ->
  966:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  967:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  968:     Liar = ?config(third, Config),
  969:     LiarKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  970:     LiarEndpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
  971:     TargetKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  972:     TargetAnchor = ?config(target_anchor, Config),
  973:     ThirdAnchor = ?config(third_anchor, Config),
  974:     LyingRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  975:                  {?NS, TargetAnchor, validator}],
  976:     HonestRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  977:                   {?NS, TargetAnchor, observer}],
  978:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  979:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  980:                 [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, LyingRows, 1, 2]),
  981:     try
  982:         {known, Routes} = peer:call(
  983:                             Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS]),
  984:         ValidatorKeys = [Key || #{role := validator, node_key := Key} <- Routes],
  985:         ?assertEqual([LiarKey, TargetKey], ValidatorKeys),
  986:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)),
  987:         AtomsBefore = peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count]),
  988:         assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Target, Liar),
  989:         ?assertEqual(
  990:            AtomsBefore, peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count])),
  991:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config))
  992:     after
  993:         {ok, _} = peer:call(
  994:                     Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  995:                     [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, HonestRows, 1, 3])
  996:     end.
  997: 
  998: assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Validator, RefusedHost) ->
  999:     wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 200),
 1000:     wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200),
 1001:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
 1002:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
 1003:                        [quod_prolog, prove_ro, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
 1004:     try
 1005:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 1, 1500),
 1006:         ?assertEqual(0, scope_worker_count(RefusedHost))
 1007:     after
 1008:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
 1009:         wait_engine_stat(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, proof_workers, 0, 500),
 1010:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 500),
 1011:         wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200)
 1012:     end.
 1013: 
 1014: scope_worker_count(Peer) ->
 1015:     maps:get(scope_workers,
 1016:              peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [?NS]), undefined).
 1017: 
 1018: assert_symbol_opaque(Peer, SymbolName) ->
 1019:     ?assertEqual(
 1020:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
 1021:        peer:call(Peer, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).
 1022: 
 1023: remote_scope_solutions(Config) ->
 1024:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1025:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, {'D'}}},
 1026:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'D' := {'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>}}], _},
 1027:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000)),
 1028:     All = {findall, {'D'}, Goal, {'L'}},
 1029:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [{'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>},
 1030:                                   {'$quod_symbol', <<"meat">>}]}], _},
 1031:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, All], 60000)).
 1032: 
 1033: proof_policy_refusal_local_and_remote(Config) ->
 1034:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1035:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1036:     Ns = <<"proof-policy-refusal">>,
 1037:     Source = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "proof-policy-refusal.pl"),
 1038:     ok = file:write_file(Source,
 1039:         "can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\nready.\n"),
 1040:     ok = start_namespace(Target, ?config(target_pub, Config), Ns, Source, [], Config),
 1041:     ok = peer:call(Target, quod_ct, await_applied, [Ns, 1, 10000], 15000),
 1042:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 1043:     AnimalsAnchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
 1044:     FourthAnchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?FOURTH_NS]),
 1045:     ok = enrollment_route(Asker, ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 1046:         [{Ns, Anchor, validator}, {?NS, AnimalsAnchor, validator},
 1047:          {?FOURTH_NS, FourthAnchor, validator},
 1048:          {?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}]),
 1049:     Goal = {'::', Ns, ready},
 1050:     %% Establish both real routes before closing this disposable target's
 1051:     %% proof lane through its committed policy. No repair bypass is needed.
 1052:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Origin}) ->
 1053:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _},
 1054:             peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove_ro, [Origin, Goal], 15000))
 1055:     end, [{Target, ?NS}, {Asker, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 1056:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, execute,
 1057:         [Ns, {assertz, {material_limit_override, proof, heap_bytes, 0}}], 15000)),
 1058:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Origin}) ->
 1059:         ?assertMatch({error, {material_limit, proof, heap_bytes, Actual, 0}}
 1060:                      when Actual > 0,
 1061:             peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove_ro, [Origin, Goal], 15000))
 1062:     end, [{Target, ?NS}, {Asker, ?ASKER_NS}]).
 1063: 
 1064: answer_policy_producer_consumer_and_signed_change(Config) ->
 1065:     Target = ?config(target, Config), Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1066:     Ns = <<"answer-policy-target">>, Value = binary:copy(<<"a">>, 80000),
 1067:     Source = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "answer-policy-target.pl"),
 1068:     ok = file:write_file(Source, [
 1069:         "can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n",
 1070:         "material_limit_override(proof, answer_bytes, 1000).\n",
 1071:         "answer_value(<<\"", Value, "\">>).\n"]),
 1072:     ok = start_namespace(Target, ?config(target_pub, Config), Ns, Source, [], Config),
 1073:     ok = peer:call(Target, quod_ct, await_applied, [Ns, 1, 10000], 15000),
 1074:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 1075:     ok = enrollment_route(Asker, ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 1076:         [{Ns, Anchor, validator}, {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), validator},
 1077:          {?FOURTH_NS, peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?FOURTH_NS]), validator},
 1078:          {?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}]),
 1079:     Goal = {'::', Ns, {answer_value, {'Value'}}},
 1080:     {ok, Canonical} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical({answer_value, Value}),
 1081:     Actual = byte_size(Canonical),
 1082:     Expected = {error, {material_limit, proof, answer_bytes, Actual, 1000}},
 1083:     %% Same selected producer, direct/cohosted/remote consumers.
 1084:     ?assertEqual(Expected, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
 1085:                                     [Ns, {answer_value, {'Value'}}], 15000)),
 1086:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Origin}) ->
 1087:         ?assertEqual(Expected, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove_ro, [Origin, Goal], 15000))
 1088:     end, [{Target, ?NS}, {Asker, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 1089:     %% Raise through the ordinary signed action, under the OLD committed policy.
 1090:     Selector = {'$quod_symbol', Ns},
 1091:     Raise = {'::', Selector, {',', {retract, {material_limit_override, proof, answer_bytes, 1000}},
 1092:                             {assertz, {material_limit_override, proof, answer_bytes, 120000}}}},
 1093:     {ok, RaiseText} = quod_client_goal_parser:format(Raise),
 1094:     {ok, _} = quod_client_goal_parser:parse(RaiseText, 1),
 1095:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
 1096:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, RaiseText)),
 1097:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Origin}) ->
 1098:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'Value' := Value}], _},
 1099:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove_ro, [Origin, Goal], 15000))
 1100:     end, [{Target, ?NS}, {Asker, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 1101:     %% The outer rule exposes no large binding. Its receiving proof must still
 1102:     %% account for the computed foreign answer before consuming/discarding it.
 1103:     Rule = {':-', answer_seen, {'::', Selector, {answer_value, {0}}}},
 1104:     {ok, RuleText} = quod_client_goal_parser:format({assertz, Rule}),
 1105:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
 1106:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, RuleText)),
 1107:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1108:     Read = fun() ->
 1109:         {Bytes, Sig} = signed_goal_request(?config(network_id, Config),
 1110:             ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1111:             ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1112:             read, <<"answer_seen.">>),
 1113:         peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1114:             [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes, Sig, ?config(client_peer, Config)], 60000)
 1115:     end,
 1116:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _, [_]}}}}, Read()),
 1117:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
 1118:         submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1119:             <<"assertz(material_limit_override(proof, answer_bytes, 1000)).">>)),
 1120:     ?assertEqual(Expected, peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
 1121:                                     [?ASKER_NS, answer_seen], 15000)),
 1122:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, Expected}}}, Read()),
 1123:     %% A remote allowance never grants local capacity. Restore via a new,
 1124:     %% explicitly intended small authorized action, not a replay of the read.
 1125:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
 1126:         submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1127:             <<"retract(material_limit_override(proof, answer_bytes, 1000)).">>)),
 1128:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _, [_]}}}}, Read()).
 1129: 
 1130: remote_scope_trace_parentage(Config) ->
 1131:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1132:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1133:     %% These peers use standard_io, not Erlang distribution to the CT VM.
 1134:     %% All trace collection and monitoring stay on the owning peer; neither
 1135:     %% target loads this suite's intentionally caller-only vocabulary.
 1136:     Collector = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, start, []),
 1137:     try
 1138:         {Result, Public, Open, Directory, ScopeOpen, Request} = peer:call(
 1139:                                                                  Asker,
 1140:                                                                  quod_trace_fixture,
 1141:                                                                  prove,
 1142:                                                                  [?ASKER_NS,
 1143:                                                                   {'::', ?NS,
 1144:                                                                    {diet, dog,
 1145:                                                                     {'D'}}}],
 1146:                                                                  60000),
 1147:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'D' := {'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>}}], _}, Result),
 1148:         ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Open#span.trace_id),
 1149:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Directory#span.parent_span_id),
 1150:         ?assertEqual(Directory#span.span_id, ScopeOpen#span.parent_span_id),
 1151:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Request#span.parent_span_id),
 1152:         Auth = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
 1153:                          [Collector, <<"quod.scope.authenticate">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
 1154:         InvokeOpen = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
 1155:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_open">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
 1156:         InvokeNext = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
 1157:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_next">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
 1158:         %% These spans are emitted by the actual remote authentication worker
 1159:         %% and target invocation worker, not by a codec-only fixture.
 1160:         lists:foreach(fun(Span) ->
 1161:             ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Span#span.trace_id),
 1162:             ?assertEqual(ScopeOpen#span.span_id, Span#span.parent_span_id),
 1163:             ?assert(Span#span.parent_span_is_remote),
 1164:             ?assert(Span#span.end_time >= Span#span.start_time)
 1165:         end, [Auth, InvokeOpen, InvokeNext])
 1166:     after
 1167:         ok = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, stop, [Collector])
 1168:     end.
 1169: 
 1170: remote_scope_symbol_safety(Config) ->
 1171:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1172:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1173:     Echo = {'::', ?NS, {echo, asker_only_symbol}},
 1174:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
 1175:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1176:                            [?ASKER_NS, Echo], 60000)),
 1177:     ?assertEqual({ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"asker_only_symbol">>}},
 1178:                  peer:call(Target, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1179:                            [{0, <<"asker_only_symbol">>}])),
 1180:     Unknown = {'::', ?NS, {asker_only_predicate, x}},
 1181:     ?assertMatch(fail,
 1182:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1183:                            [?ASKER_NS, Unknown], 60000)).
 1184: 
 1185: %% A retains the new predicate as an opaque symbol. C alone starts with its
 1186: %% fact. B materializes the spelling from a deliberately failing local branch
 1187: %% while leaving C's nested goal opaque, then C returns that same symbol. Both
 1188: %% simultaneous first-use requests must bind without a failed seed request.
 1189: remote_signed_fresh_nested_symbol(Config) ->
 1190:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1191:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1192:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1193:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1194:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1195:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1196:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1197:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1198:     RaceSuffix = integer_to_list(erlang:unique_integer([positive])),
 1199:     RacePredicateText = "quod_fresh_race_" ++ RaceSuffix,
 1200:     RacePredicate = list_to_atom(RacePredicateText),
 1201:     ?assertMatch(
 1202:        {ok, [_], _},
 1203:        peer:call(
 1204:          Third, quod_prolog, prove,
 1205:          [?THIRD_NS, {assertz, {RacePredicate, ok}}], 60000)),
 1206:     RaceGoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1207:                      ["\"animals\"::((", RacePredicateText,
 1208:                       "(ok), fail); \"third\"::", RacePredicateText,
 1209:                       "(ok))."]),
 1210:     Requests =
 1211:         [signed_goal_request(
 1212:            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1213:            maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read, RaceGoalText)
 1214:          || _ <- [first, second]],
 1215:     Parent = self(),
 1216:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1217:     Workers =
 1218:         [spawn(
 1219:            fun() ->
 1220:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
 1221:                Parent !
 1222:                    {RaceRef, Label,
 1223:                     peer:call(
 1224:                       Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1225:                       [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes,
 1226:                        RequestSignature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1227:            end)
 1228:          || {Label, {Bytes, RequestSignature}} <-
 1229:                 lists:zip([first, second], Requests)],
 1230:     lists:foreach(fun(Worker) -> Worker ! {RaceRef, go} end, Workers),
 1231:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
 1232:     lists:foreach(
 1233:       fun({_Label,
 1234:            {ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _Height, [_Answer]}}}}}) -> ok;
 1235:          ({Label, Other}) -> error({fresh_symbol_race_failed, Label, Other})
 1236:       end, Results).
 1237: 
 1238: remote_scope_chain_policy(Config) ->
 1239:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1240:     Allowed = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {secret, {'X'}}},
 1241:     ?assertMatch(
 1242:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
 1243:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1244:                  [?ASKER_NS, Allowed], 60000)),
 1245:     %% A refusal crosses QUIC as ordinary logical failure carrying its bounded
 1246:     %% reason, so the caller can inspect it and branch — same contract as the
 1247:     %% co-hosted path.
 1248:     Denied = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {hidden, {'X'}}},
 1249:     {fail, DeniedReasons} =
 1250:         peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1251:                   [?ASKER_NS, Denied], 60000),
 1252:     ?assert(lists:member({not_allowed, ?PRIVATE_NS}, DeniedReasons)),
 1253:     ?assertMatch(
 1254:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
 1255:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1256:                  [?ASKER_NS, {';', Denied, Allowed}], 60000)),
 1257:     {known, Routes} = peer:call(
 1258:                         Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?PRIVATE_NS]),
 1259:     ?assert(Routes =/= []),
 1260:     ?assert(lists:all(
 1261:               fun(#{scope := private, status := confirmed}) -> true;
 1262:                  (_) -> false
 1263:               end, Routes)),
 1264:     ?assertEqual([], peer:call(
 1265:                        Asker, quod_directory, directory_hosts,
 1266:                        [?PRIVATE_NS])).
 1267: 
 1268: remote_scope_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1269:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1270:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {blocked, bob}},
 1271:     Recover = {';', Remote,
 1272:                {get_fail_reasons,
 1273:                 [{impossible_to_link, bob}]}},
 1274:     ?assertMatch(
 1275:        {ok, [#{}], _},
 1276:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1277:                  [?ASKER_NS, Recover], 60000)).
 1278: 
 1279: %% The C predicate name is compiled only on B/C. A relays it without allocating
 1280: %% an atom; C materializes it after authenticating the scoped command. A's
 1281: %% declared recovery rule then matches C's reason after it returns through B.
 1282: remote_scope_nested_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1283:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1284:     ?assertMatch(
 1285:        {ok, [#{}], _},
 1286:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1287:                  [?ASKER_NS, recover_third_failure], 60000)),
 1288:     ?assertEqual(
 1289:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"third_blocked">>}},
 1290:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1291:                  [{0, <<"third_blocked">>}])),
 1292:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1293:       Asker, ?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS,
 1294:       ?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
 1295:       <<"third_blocked">>).
 1296: 
 1297: remote_scope_deep_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1298:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1299:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {deep_failure, 70}},
 1300:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1301:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1302:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1303:     %% Every explicit entry survives, in newest-first order, beyond the old quota.
 1304:     ?assertEqual([{'$quod_symbol', <<"deep_bottom">>} |
 1305:                   [{reason, N} || N <- lists:seq(1, 70)]], Reasons),
 1306:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1307:       Asker, ?config(target, Config), ?NS,
 1308:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 1309:       <<"deep_bottom">>).
 1310: 
 1311: assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1312:   Asker, Host, Ns, HostKey, Endpoint, SymbolName) ->
 1313:     Anchor = peer:call(Host, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 1314:     ?assertMatch(
 1315:        {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}}},
 1316:        peer:call(
 1317:          Asker, quod_foreign_log, current,
 1318:          [[{HostKey, [Endpoint]}], {Ns, Anchor}, 20000], 25000)),
 1319:     %% current/3 must be able to certify and retain the complete foreign
 1320:     %% history without interning that ontology's application vocabulary.
 1321:     ?assertEqual(
 1322:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
 1323:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).
 1324: 
 1325: remote_scope_structural_reason_depth(Config) ->
 1326:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1327:     %% The wire codec chooses no nesting quota: a reason built at proof time
 1328:     %% crosses the remote proof boundary whole, without a truncation marker.
 1329:     {ok, Bottom} = peer:call(
 1330:                      Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1331:                      [{0, <<"deep_bottom">>}]),
 1332:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, deep_reason},
 1333:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1334:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1335:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1336:     Reason = lists:foldl(
 1337:                fun(_, Acc) -> [Acc] end, Bottom, lists:seq(1, 70)),
 1338:     ?assertEqual([Reason], Reasons),
 1339:     ?assertNot(lists:member(fail_reasons_truncated, Reasons)),
 1340:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(Reasons)).
 1341: 
 1342: remote_scope_cancel(Config) ->
 1343:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1344:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1345:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
 1346:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
 1347:                        [quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
 1348:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 1, 200),
 1349:     true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
 1350:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).
 1351: 
 1352: %% Scope commands share the bounded node-level router without sharing proof
 1353: %% state. Two full waves prove that completed scopes release every target worker
 1354: %% and leave the transport reusable for independent proofs.
 1355: remote_scope_transport_reuse(Config) ->
 1356:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1357:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1358:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}},
 1359:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, first),
 1360:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200),
 1361:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, second),
 1362:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).
 1363: 
 1364: %% The selector owns this empty origin fixture snapshot on the originating peer;
 1365: %% its signed foreign scope reads the real target under that target's ACL.
 1366: committed_remote_read(Evidence = #{request := #{agent_namespace := Ns,
 1367:         agent_genesis_anchor := Anchor,not_after_ms := Expiry},goal := Frozen}) ->
 1368:     {ok,Goal} = quod_wire_term:materialize_symbols(Frozen),
 1369:     Est = quod_predicates:set_context(quod_ct:committed_kb([]),
 1370:                                      quod_predicates:proof_context(Ns,1,[])),
 1371:     quod_prolog:prove_est(Goal,Est,#{identity => {Ns,Anchor},height => 1,
 1372:         deadline_ms => quod_time:mono_ms() + max(0,Expiry-quod_time:now_ms()),
 1373:         evidence => Evidence}).
 1374: 
 1375: %% The browser is logged into A as an agent stored in A. Exact selectors reach
 1376: %% B through the ordinary scope path. A has no ACL clause for these goals, so
 1377: %% success proves that A authenticates identity while B alone authorizes B's
 1378: %% predicate.
 1379: remote_signed_gateway_read_execute_cursor(Config) ->
 1380:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1381:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1382:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1383:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1384:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1385:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1386:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1387:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1388: 
 1389:     {ReadBytes, ReadSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1390:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1391:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1392:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read,
 1393:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1394:     {ok, ReadEvidence,
 1395:      {normalized, {read, ReadDependencies, {answers, ReadHeight, ReadBlobs}}}} =
 1396:         peer:call(
 1397:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1398:           [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), ReadBytes, ReadSignature, Peer],
 1399:           60000),
 1400:     ?assertEqual({?ASKER_NS,AgentAnchor,ReadHeight},
 1401:         lists:keyfind(?ASKER_NS,1,[{N,A,H} || {N,A,H,_} <- ReadDependencies])),
 1402:     ?assertEqual({?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config),
 1403:                   peer:call(?config(target,Config),quod_prolog,applied,[?NS])},
 1404:         lists:keyfind(?NS,1,[{N,A,H} || {N,A,H,_} <- ReadDependencies])),
 1405:     ?assert(lists:all(fun({_,_,_,Reads}) -> Reads =:= [] end,ReadDependencies)),
 1406:     {read,SelectorDependencies,{ok,_,_,_}} =
 1407:         peer:call(Asker,?MODULE,committed_remote_read,[ReadEvidence],60000),
 1408:     {?NS,_,_,RemoteReads} = lists:keyfind(?NS,1,SelectorDependencies),
 1409:     ?assert(quod_read_set:valid_pairs(RemoteReads)),
 1410:     ?assert(lists:any(fun
 1411:         ({{Symbol,2},_}) -> quod_wire_term:symbol_names(Symbol) =:= {ok,[<<"diet">>]};
 1412:         (_) -> false
 1413:     end,RemoteReads)),
 1414:     ?assertEqual(ReadBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, ReadEvidence)),
 1415:     ?assertEqual(ReadSignature, maps:get(signature, ReadEvidence)),
 1416:     ?assertEqual(
 1417:        [[{<<"D">>, kibble}]],
 1418:        [begin {ok, Binding} = quod_durable_term:decode_result(Blob), Binding end
 1419:         || Blob <- ReadBlobs]),
 1420:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1421:     ExecuteText = iolist_to_binary(
 1422:                     io_lib:format("assertz(gateway_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1423:     {ExecuteBytes, ExecuteSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1424:                                          NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1425:                                          ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1426:                                          maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1427:                                          execute,
 1428:                                          <<"\"animals\"::", ExecuteText/binary>>),
 1429:     {ok, ExecuteEvidence,
 1430:      {normalized,
 1431:       {committed, [_],
 1432:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = ExecuteTargetRef}}} =
 1433:         peer:call(
 1434:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1435:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), ExecuteBytes,
 1436:            ExecuteSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1437:     ?assertEqual(
 1438:        ExecuteTargetRef,
 1439:        completed_remote_operation(
 1440:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, ExecuteEvidence), 600)),
 1441:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_mark, Tag),
 1442: 
 1443:     CursorText =
 1444:         <<"\"animals\"::(diet(dog, D), assertz(gateway_choice(D))).">>,
 1445:     {CursorBytes, CursorSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1446:                                        NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1447:                                        ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1448:                                        maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1449:                                        cursor, CursorText),
 1450:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1451:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, FirstBlob}}} =
 1452:         peer:call(
 1453:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1454:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorBytes,
 1455:            CursorSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1456:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, kibble}]},
 1457:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(FirstBlob)),
 1458:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1459:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, SecondBlob}}} =
 1460:         peer:call(
 1461:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1462:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, next, Peer], 60000),
 1463:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, meat}]},
 1464:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(SecondBlob)),
 1465:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1466:      {normalized,
 1467:       {committed, [_],
 1468:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = CursorTargetRef}}} =
 1469:         peer:call(
 1470:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1471:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, accept, Peer], 60000),
 1472:     ?assertEqual(
 1473:        CursorTargetRef,
 1474:        completed_remote_operation(
 1475:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, CursorEvidence), 600)),
 1476:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_choice, meat),
 1477: 
 1478:     {StopBytes, StopSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1479:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1480:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1481:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor,
 1482:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1483:     {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, StopCursor, _, _}}} =
 1484:         peer:call(
 1485:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1486:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), StopBytes,
 1487:            StopSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1488:     ?assertMatch(
 1489:        {ok, _, {normalized, stopped}},
 1490:        peer:call(
 1491:          Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1492:          [maps:get(session_id, Session), StopCursor, stop, Peer], 60000)).
 1493: 
 1494: %% B contributes only a certified read. C remains the sole writer, so this is
 1495: %% one ordinary remote operation claim and target transaction, never a DTX
 1496: %% group with an empty source Vote/Resolve role for B.
 1497: remote_signed_read_certified_write(Config) ->
 1498:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1499:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1500:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1501:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1502:                  io_lib:format(
 1503:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), "
 1504:                    "\"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1505:     {ok, Evidence,
 1506:      {normalized,
 1507:       {committed, [_],
 1508:        {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, _} = TargetRef}}} =
 1509:         submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText),
 1510:     ?assertEqual(
 1511:        ThirdAnchor,
 1512:        peer:call(Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS])),
 1513:     ?assertEqual(
 1514:        TargetRef,
 1515:        completed_remote_operation(
 1516:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1517:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1518: 
 1519: %% R4-UNCERTAIN-CLAIM-DELIVERY-01: this is a real signed operation admitted
 1520: %% through the ordinary client, source consensus, and remote target. Once it
 1521: %% is accepted, deliver the SAME durable claim twice more through the real
 1522: %% endpoint. Only the transport correlation id changes. No hand-built claim,
 1523: %% new signed goal, new application identity, or admission bypass is used.
 1524: remote_exact_claim_redelivery(Config) ->
 1525:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1526:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1527:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1528:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1529:              "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1530:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_],
 1531:         {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, Anchor, TxId} = TargetRef}}} =
 1532:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1533:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1534:     ?assertEqual(TargetRef, completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600)),
 1535:     {ok, #{height := ClaimSlot}} = peer:call(
 1536:         Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, OperationRef]),
 1537:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1538:     {ok, CertifiedClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(
 1539:         Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1540:         [?ASKER_NS, ClaimSlot, OperationRef, Deadline]),
 1541:     {ok, ClaimBytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim),
 1542:     Target = {?THIRD_NS, Anchor},
 1543:     StableClaimRef = quod_transaction:stable_ref(CertifiedClaimRef),
 1544:     ?assertMatch(#transaction{tx_id = TxId},
 1545:         quod_transaction:remote_application(StableClaimRef, Claim, Target)),
 1546:     Before = peer:call(Third, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences,
 1547:                        [?THIRD_NS, TxId]),
 1548:     ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1549:     lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1550:         ?assertEqual({ok, ClaimBytes},
 1551:                      quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim)),
 1552:         RequestId = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 1553:         Request = {apply_claim, RequestId, Target, ClaimBytes},
 1554:         {ok, {application, RequestId, committed, ApplicationBytes} = Response,
 1555:          _Hints} =
 1556:             peer:call(Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1557:                       [?ASKER_NS, Target, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000),
 1558:         ?assert(quod_dtx_endpoint:correlates(Request, Response)),
 1559:         {ok, ApplicationRef, #transaction{tx_id = TxId,
 1560:             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}}} =
 1561:             quod_transaction:decode_evidence(ApplicationBytes),
 1562:         ?assertEqual(TargetRef, quod_transaction:stable_ref(ApplicationRef)),
 1563:         ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Third, ?MODULE,
 1564:             claim_application_occurrences, [?THIRD_NS, TxId])),
 1565:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag)
 1566:     end, [first_redelivery, second_redelivery]).
 1567: 
 1568: %% Test-side audit only, executed ON the target. An ordinary immutable owner
 1569: %% snapshot is read without returning any store or interpreter state to the
 1570: %% caller. Count ledger occurrences as well as visible facts: an extra inert
 1571: %% or rejected envelope must not hide a second application under the same id.
 1572: claim_application_occurrences(Ns, TxId) ->
 1573:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1574:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1575:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1576:     try
 1577:         lists:reverse(quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1578:             fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1579:                 case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1580:                     #entry{index = Slot, data = {batch, Transactions}} ->
 1581:                         [Slot || #transaction{tx_id = Id,
 1582:                             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}} <- Transactions,
 1583:                             Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1584:                     _ -> Acc
 1585:                 end
 1586:             end, []))
 1587:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1588:     end.
 1589: 
 1590: %% A writes locally while B contributes only a certified read. The result is
 1591: %% A's ordinary transaction; there is no source claim and no DTX group.
 1592: local_write_with_foreign_read(Config) ->
 1593:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1594:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1595:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1596:                  io_lib:format(
 1597:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1598:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1599:     ?assertMatch(
 1600:        {ok, _,
 1601:         {normalized,
 1602:          {committed, [_], {transaction, ?ASKER_NS, _, _}}}},
 1603:        submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)),
 1604:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1605: 
 1606: %% The read token is sealed first. B then commits another diet/2 fact before
 1607: %% its validators sign the certificate. Certification must reject the stale
 1608: %% token and A's local write must remain absent.
 1609: read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1610:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1611:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1612:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1613:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1614:                  io_lib:format(
 1615:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1616:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1617:     ok = peer:call(
 1618:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1619:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1620:     Parent = self(),
 1621:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1622:     _ = spawn(
 1623:           fun() ->
 1624:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1625:           end),
 1626:     try
 1627:         ok = peer:call(
 1628:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1629:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1630:         ?assertMatch(
 1631:            {ok, [_], _},
 1632:            peer:call(
 1633:              Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1634:              [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {stale_marker, Tag}}}],
 1635:              60000))
 1636:     after
 1637:         %% Never leave the TEST-only rendezvous installed if an assertion
 1638:         %% above fails: a later proof would otherwise correctly wait forever.
 1639:         _ = peer:call(
 1640:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1641:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1642:     end,
 1643:     Result = receive
 1644:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1645:              after 60000 ->
 1646:                  ct:fail(stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1647:              end,
 1648:     ?assertMatch(
 1649:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1650:     assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1651: 
 1652: %% The signed claim lane treats A's own read exactly like any other read-only
 1653: %% dependency. If A changes after sealing but before certification, neither the
 1654: %% source claim nor C's write may be submitted.
 1655: remote_signed_origin_read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1656:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1657:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1658:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1659:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1660:                  io_lib:format(
 1661:                    "instance_of(pet, my_dog), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).",
 1662:                    [Tag])),
 1663:     ok = peer:call(
 1664:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1665:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1666:     Parent = self(),
 1667:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1668:     _ = spawn(
 1669:           fun() ->
 1670:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1671:           end),
 1672:     try
 1673:         ok = peer:call(
 1674:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1675:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1676:         %% The source proof is deliberately parked before its certificate.
 1677:         %% Commit the intervening source-head change at the consensus seam so
 1678:         %% this test does not depend on a second client ingress being admitted
 1679:         %% while the first signed request still owns that ingress session.
 1680:         append_source_marker(Config, Tag)
 1681:     after
 1682:         _ = peer:call(
 1683:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1684:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1685:     end,
 1686:     Result = receive
 1687:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1688:              after 60000 ->
 1689:                  ct:fail(origin_stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1690:              end,
 1691:     ?assertMatch(
 1692:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1693:     assert_fact_absent(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1694: 
 1695: %% Two independent gateways race the same signed execute. One may receive a
 1696: %% typed pre-custody availability refusal while the other proof is sealing;
 1697: %% the stable operation claim must still give both gateways one durable result
 1698: %% and one material write.
 1699: remote_signed_two_gateway_race(Config) ->
 1700:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1701:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1702:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1703:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1704:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1705:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1706:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1707:     AskerSession = open_client_session(
 1708:                      Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 1709:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1710:     ThirdSession = open_client_session(
 1711:                      Third, NetworkId, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1712:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1713:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1714:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1715:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1716:                  io_lib:format(
 1717:                    "\"animals\"::assertz(gateway_race_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1718:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, AskerSession),
 1719:                   maps:get(expires_ms, ThirdSession)),
 1720:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1721:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1722:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1723:                                   Expires, execute, GoalText),
 1724:     Parent = self(),
 1725:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1726:     _ = spawn(
 1727:           fun() ->
 1728:               Parent !
 1729:                 {RaceRef, asker,
 1730:                  peer:call(
 1731:                    Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1732:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession),
 1733:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1734:           end),
 1735:     _ = spawn(
 1736:           fun() ->
 1737:               Parent !
 1738:                 {RaceRef, third,
 1739:                  peer:call(
 1740:                    Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1741:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession),
 1742:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1743:           end),
 1744:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
 1745:     Classified = [classify_race_submit(Result)
 1746:                   || {_Gateway, Result} <- Results],
 1747:     Evidences = [Ev || {accepted, Ev} <- Classified],
 1748:     %% A simultaneous second proof may be refused before durable custody while
 1749:     %% the first proof is still sealing. That refusal is safe because both
 1750:     %% gateways retain the exact same signed request and operation reference;
 1751:     %% after the first claim commits, either gateway must resolve it.
 1752:     ?assert(Evidences =/= []),
 1753:     [Evidence | _] = Evidences,
 1754:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1755:     lists:foreach(
 1756:       fun(Ev) ->
 1757:           ?assertEqual(OperationRef, maps:get(operation_ref, Ev)),
 1758:           ?assertEqual(RequestBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, Ev)),
 1759:           ?assertEqual(Signature, maps:get(signature, Ev))
 1760:       end, Evidences),
 1761:     OutcomeRef = {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} =
 1762:         completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 1763:     ?assertEqual(
 1764:        TargetAnchor,
 1765:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS])),
 1766:     ?assertMatch(
 1767:        {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 1768:               outcome_ref := {applications, [{transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _}]}}},
 1769:        peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
 1770:     ?assertMatch(
 1771:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1772:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1773:                 #{status := completed,
 1774:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1775:        wait_remote_operation(
 1776:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession), RequestBytes,
 1777:          Signature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 1778:     {ok, #{status := committed, height := OutcomeHeight, ref := OutcomeRef}} =
 1779:         peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]),
 1780:     %% Third is an observer of the target ontology. A remote result at Asker
 1781:     %% does not mean Third's local projection has consumed the target block.
 1782:     %% Wait for that actual event; do not resubmit, nudge the feed, or replace
 1783:     %% the fixture's ordering requirement with a short repeated resolve loop.
 1784:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_ct, await_applied,
 1785:                    [?NS, OutcomeHeight, 10000], 15000),
 1786:     ?assertMatch(
 1787:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1788:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1789:                 #{status := completed,
 1790:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1791:        peer:call(
 1792:          Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1793:          [maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession), RequestBytes,
 1794:           Signature, ClientPeer], 10000)),
 1795:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_race_mark, Tag).
 1796: 
 1797: %% A signed agent stored in A reaches B and then C through the same nested
 1798: %% scope and group machinery. No specialized client or agent executor exists.
 1799: %% Real signed proofs use the same action evaluator locally at animals, on
 1800: %% its co-hosted fourth namespace, and remotely at third. The first candidate
 1801: %% crosses both boundaries, stages facts/events, cuts and fails. Only the
 1802: %% complete second candidate may reach any target ledger.
 1803: independent_action_multiscope_rollback(Config) ->
 1804:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1805:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1806:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1807:       "animals::(assertz((action_bad(~B) :- "
 1808:       "assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B)), "
 1809:       "fourth::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), "
 1810:       "third::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), !, fail)), "
 1811:       "assertz((action_good(~B) :- assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B)), "
 1812:       "fourth::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))), "
 1813:       "third::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))))), "
 1814:       "assertz(action(action_bad(~B), [], action_done(~B))), "
 1815:       "assertz(action(action_good(~B), [], action_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(18, Tag))),
 1816:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1817:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1818:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, Rows}}}} =
 1819:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1820:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1821:     ?assertEqual([?NS, ?FOURTH_NS, ?THIRD_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1822:     Owners = #{?NS => ?config(target, Config), ?FOURTH_NS => ?config(target, Config),
 1823:                ?THIRD_NS => ?config(third, Config)},
 1824:     lists:foreach(fun({{Ns, _}, {committed, {transaction, Ns, _, Id}}}) ->
 1825:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1826:         assert_fact_once(Peer, Ns, action_done, Tag),
 1827:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_leak, Tag),
 1828:         Changes = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, action_application_changes, [Ns, Id]),
 1829:         ?assertEqual([{action_done, Tag}], [E || {event, E} <- Changes])
 1830:     end, Rows).
 1831: 
 1832: independent_action_remote_errors(Config) ->
 1833:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1834:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1835:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1836:       "animals::(assertz((action_error(~B) :- assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), "
 1837:       "third::(assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), assertz(true)))), "
 1838:       "assertz(action(action_error(~B), [], action_error_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(5, Tag))),
 1839:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1840:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_error_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1841:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1842:     Capture = peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, start_action_error_capture, []),
 1843:     {Result, Errors} = try
 1844:         {submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1845:          peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture])}
 1846:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
 1847:         peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture]),
 1848:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
 1849:     end,
 1850:     %% Public normalization deliberately hides language descriptors. Pin the
 1851:     %% original error at the real worker return, then the unchanged public form.
 1852:     ?assert(lists:member({permission_error, modify, static_procedure, {'/', true, 0}}, Errors)),
 1853:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, proof_unavailable}}}, Result),
 1854:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 1855:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_error_leak, Tag)
 1856:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
 1857: 
 1858: start_action_error_capture() ->
 1859:     Pid = spawn(fun() -> action_error_capture([], none) end),
 1860:     1 = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, [{'_', [], [{return_trace}]}], [local]),
 1861:     _ = erlang:trace(all, true, [call, {tracer, Pid}]),
 1862:     Pid.
 1863: 
 1864: finish_action_error_capture(Pid) ->
 1865:     _ = erlang:trace(all, false, [call]),
 1866:     _ = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, false, [local]),
 1867:     Ref = make_ref(), Pid ! {finish, self(), Ref},
 1868:     receive {Ref, Errors} -> Errors after 5000 -> erlang:error(action_trace_timeout) end.
 1869: 
 1870: action_error_capture(Errors, Closing) ->
 1871:     receive
 1872:         {trace, _, return_from, {quod_proof_scope, next, 1},
 1873:          {error, {erlog, Reason}, _, _}} ->
 1874:             true = length(Errors) < 16,
 1875:             action_error_capture([Reason | Errors], Closing);
 1876:         {finish, Caller, Ref} ->
 1877:             Delivery = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
 1878:             action_error_capture(Errors, {Caller, Ref, Delivery});
 1879:         {trace_delivered, all, Delivery} ->
 1880:             {Caller, Ref, Delivery} = Closing, Caller ! {Ref, Errors};
 1881:         _ -> action_error_capture(Errors, Closing)
 1882:     end.
 1883: 
 1884: action_application_changes(Ns, TxId) ->
 1885:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1886:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1887:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1888:     try
 1889:         [Changes] = quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1890:           fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1891:               case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1892:                   #entry{data = {batch, Txs}} ->
 1893:                       [Diff || #transaction{tx_id = Id, diff = Diff} <- Txs,
 1894:                                Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1895:                   _ -> Acc
 1896:               end
 1897:           end, []),
 1898:         Changes
 1899:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1900:     end.
 1901: 
 1902: %% Root's governed create_ontology bridge uses the same action evaluator and
 1903: %% its private savepoint. The other target writes ordinary facts; Root remains
 1904: %% effect-only, and exact durable claim redelivery cannot repeat the effect.
 1905: independent_action_remote_prepared_rollback(Config) ->
 1906:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1907:     Discarded = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-discarded-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1908:     Kept = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-kept-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1909:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1910:       "(assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1911:       "assertz((action_effect_bad(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), !, fail)), "
 1912:       "assertz((action_effect_good(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), assertz(action_effect_done(~B)))), "
 1913:       "assertz(action(action_effect_bad(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B))), "
 1914:       "assertz(action(action_effect_good(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B)))).",
 1915:       [Tag, Tag, Discarded, Tag, Kept, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag])),
 1916:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1917:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("independent(goal(action_effect_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1918:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1919:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1920:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1921:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1922:     Target = ?config(target, Config), Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1923:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])),
 1924:     ?assertEqual({ok, ready}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Kept])),
 1925:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, action_effect_done, Tag),
 1926:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1927:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])).
 1928: 
 1929: remote_independent_root_effect(Config) ->
 1930:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1931:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1932:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:s8-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1933:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1934:       "independent((assertz(s8_effect_mark(~B)), "
 1935:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 1936:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 1937:       "s8_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor))).", [Tag, CreatedNs])),
 1938:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1939:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1940:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1941:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1942:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1943:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1944:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {s8_effect_created, ok}),
 1945:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs]),
 1946:     ?assertMatch(<<_:256>>, Anchor),
 1947:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1948:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs])),
 1949:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1950:     #{included := Receipt} = peer:call(Asker, quod_ct, await_operation_complete,
 1951:                                       [?ASKER_NS, Op, 5000], 10000),
 1952:     ?assert(quod_operation_vector:certified(Receipt)).

 1954: remote_independent_routes(Config) ->
 1955:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1956:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1957:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
 1958:       submit_signed_execute(Config, <<"animals::independent(true).">>)),
 1959:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1960:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1961:       "animals::independent(assertz(s6_remote(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1962:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], Ref}}} =
 1963:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1964:     ?assertMatch({transaction, ?NS, _, _}, Ref),
 1965:     ?assertEqual(Ref, completed_remote_operation(
 1966:                        Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1967:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, s6_remote, Tag),
 1968:     lists:foreach(fun(Goal) ->
 1969:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1970:                      submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal))
 1971:     end, [<<"independent((assertz(s6_ab), animals::assertz(s6_ab))).">>,
 1972:           <<"animals::independent((assertz(s6_bc), third::assertz(s6_bc))).">>]),
 1973:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns, Fact}) ->
 1974:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Fact]))
 1975:     end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s6_ab}, {Target, ?NS, s6_ab},
 1976:           {Target, ?NS, s6_bc}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_bc}]).

 1978: %% L2-S8-DEFERRED-7.4-ADMITTED-PARTIAL-OUTCOME: both plans are genuinely
 1979: %% sealed, then one target's read becomes stale before claim admission. The
 1980: %% shared applier rejects ONLY that target. No hand-built claim or bypass.
 1981: remote_independent_partial_outcome(Config) ->
 1982:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1983:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1984:     Third = ?config(third, Config), Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1985:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1986:       "animals::independent((diet(dog, kibble), assertz(s8_rejected(~B)), third::dtx_write(~B))).",
 1987:       [Tag, Tag])),
 1988:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1989:     Parent = self(), RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1990:     _ = spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal)} end),
 1991:     try
 1992:         ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1993:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1994:           [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {s8_stale_marker, Tag}}}], 60000))
 1995:     after
 1996:         _ = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1997:     end,
 1998:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1999:         receive {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 2000:         after 60000 -> ct:fail(independent_partial_outcome_timeout) end,
 2001:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 2002:     ?assertEqual(mixed, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 2003:     ?assertMatch([{{?NS, _}, {{rejected, conflict_retry}, _}},
 2004:                   {{?THIRD_NS, _}, {committed, _}}], Rows),
 2005:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 2006:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2007:     %% Repeat exact delivery after mixed completion: rejected A stays rejected,
 2008:     %% committed B stays exactly once, and neither gets a fresh application id.
 2009:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?NS => Target, ?THIRD_NS => Third}),
 2010:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 2011:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2012:     %% The source owner must recover the same complete vector for a later
 2013:     %% caller. A different gateway then verifies the source receipt and the
 2014:     %% exact AM3 target evidence; current-view status labels are insufficient.
 2015:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, ?config(client_session, Config)),
 2016:     RequestBytes = maps:get(request_bytes, Evidence), Signature = maps:get(signature, Evidence),
 2017:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 2018:       peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 2019:         [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config)], 10000)),
 2020:     ForeignSession = open_client_session(Target, ?config(network_id, Config),
 2021:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config), ?config(client_peer, Config)),
 2022:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 2023:       wait_remote_operation(Target, maps:get(session_id, ForeignSession), RequestBytes,
 2024:         Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config), 8)).

 2027: assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, Owners) ->
 2028:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2029:     {ok, #{height := Slot}} = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, Op]),
 2030:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 2031:     {ok, ClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 2032:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Slot, Op, Deadline]),
 2033:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim),
 2034:     lists:foreach(fun({Identity = {Ns, _}, {Verdict, Ref}}) ->
 2035:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 2036:         {transaction, _, _, TxId} = Ref,
 2037:         Before = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]),
 2038:         ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 2039:         lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 2040:             ?assertEqual({ok, Bytes}, quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim)),
 2041:             Id = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), Request = {apply_claim, Id, Identity, Bytes},
 2042:             ?assertMatch({ok, {application, Id, Verdict, _}, _Hints}, peer:call(
 2043:               Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 2044:               [?ASKER_NS, Identity, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000)),
 2045:             ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]))
 2046:         end, [first, second])
 2047:     end, Rows).
 2048: 
 2049: %% Positive atomic/reconnect cases establish their own route precondition. A prior
 2050: %% case may already have installed this exact fixture route; verify it then,
 2051: %% never erase it or rely on a particular suite order. Negative/recovery
 2052: %% route cases use the separately isolated read-set suite.
 2053: require_third_route_at_target(Config) ->
 2054:     Peer = ?config(target, Config), Key = ?config(third_pub, Config),
 2055:     Endpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
 2056:     Identity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 2057:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]) of
 2058:         {error, unavailable} ->
 2059:             {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2060:               [Key, Endpoint, [{?THIRD_NS, element(2, Identity), validator}], 1, 1]);
 2061:         {ok, _} -> ok
 2062:     end,
 2063:     {ok, Routes} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]),
 2064:     {Key, Endpoints} = lists:keyfind(Key, 1, Routes),
 2065:     ?assert(lists:member(Endpoint, Endpoints)),
 2066:     ok.

 2068: remote_independent_branch_provenance(Config) ->
 2069:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2070:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2071:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2072:     %% The original signed request and real sealed retained writes choose L3.
 2073:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 2074:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 2075:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f1), third::assertz(s6_f1), fail))); true).">>)),
 2076:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
 2077:                  peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f1])),
 2078:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f1])),
 2079:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, independent_mixed_writes}}},
 2080:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 2081:         <<"animals::(((assertz(s6_f2), fail); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f2))).">>)),
 2082:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 2083:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 2084:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f3), fail)); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f3))).">>)),
 2085:     %% A remotely-produced successful marker must unwind at its caller too.
 2086:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 2087:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 2088:         <<"((animals::independent((assertz(s6_unwound), third::assertz(s6_unwound))), fail); true).">>)),
 2089:     lists:foreach(fun(Fact) ->
 2090:         ?assertMatch(fail, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Fact])),
 2091:         ?assertMatch(fail, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, Fact]))
 2092:     end, [s6_f2]),
 2093:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f3])),
 2094:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f3])).

 2115: remote_independent_cursor_selects_only_accepted_answer(Config) ->
 2116:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2117:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2118:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, Session),
 2119:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2120:     lists:foreach(fun(AcceptSecond) ->
 2121:         Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2122:         Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 2123:           "animals::((independent((assertz(s6_cursor(~B)), third::assertz(s6_cursor(~B)))), X=first); X=second).",
 2124:           [Tag, Tag])),
 2125:         {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2126:           ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2127:           ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor, Text),
 2128:         {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, First}}} = peer:call(
 2129:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2130:           [cursor, SessionId, Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2131:         ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, first}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(First)),
 2132:         case AcceptSecond of
 2133:             false -> ok;
 2134:             true ->
 2135:                 {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, Second}}} = peer:call(
 2136:                   Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 2137:                   [SessionId, CursorId, next, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2138:                 ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, second}]},
 2139:                              quod_durable_term:decode_result(Second))
 2140:         end,
 2141:         Result = peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 2142:                           [SessionId, CursorId, accept, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2143:         case AcceptSecond of
 2144:             false ->
 2145:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 2146:                              {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}}, Result),
 2147:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 2148:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag);
 2149:             true ->
 2150:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 2151:                                      {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}}, Result),
 2152:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 2153:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag)
 2154:         end
 2155:     end, [false, true]).
